moreInformationList.title: Can you provide me with a generator during a planned outage?

calendarModal.title: Add to calendar
calendarModal.content: Never forget about an upcoming outage again by adding planned outages to your calendar. Learn how below.
calendarModal.btnClass: btn btn--tertiary no-underline flex gap-1 p-0 pl-6 ml-2 items-center calendar-link text-c_sm order-last

calendarItems.title: Save the calendar
calendarItems.introduction:
The calendar file contains all the necessary details of the planned power outage event happening at your property.

Your download should have started automatically. If not, please use the link below. You need to save the file to your computer.

calendarItems.title: Open the downloaded file
calendarItems.introduction: Locate the downloaded calendar file on your device and open it using your device's default calendar application.

calendarItems.title: Import the event into your calendar
calendarItems.introduction: After opening the calendar file, your device's default calendar application will recognise the file format and prompt you to import the event details. Confirm the import to add the planned power outage to your calendar.
